Matthew traces Jesus back to Abraham and David. What promises to them does Jesus come to keep?
Tamar, Rahab, Ruth and Uriah's wife are named in the line. What does their place here say about God's grace?
Joseph planned to quietly send Mary away. What do his choices show about being righteous and kind at once?
Jesus is called Immanuel, "God with us." Where do you need to know God is with you today?
The wise men travelled far and worshipped with gifts. What would it look like for you to seek Jesus that wholeheartedly?
Herod was troubled while the wise men rejoiced. Why does the news of a new King unsettle some people?
God guided Joseph through a dream to protect the child. How have you seen God protect and guide?
Even in Herod's cruelty, Matthew sees Scripture being fulfilled. What comfort is there in God's purposes going on through dark events?
John called people to repent because the kingdom was near. What does turning back to God mean for you today?
John warned that real repentance bears fruit. What fruit would show a changed heart in your life?
John said the one coming after him was far greater. How does John's humility challenge you?
At Jesus' baptism the Father says, "This is my beloved Son." What does this scene show about the Father, Son and Spirit?
Jesus answered hunger with "Man shall not live by bread alone." What are you tempted to depend on instead of God's word?
Each time, Jesus answered the devil with Scripture. Which verse would help you stand firm in your own temptations?
Jesus' first message was "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand." Why is that good news?
The fishermen left their nets immediately to follow Jesus. What might Jesus be calling you to leave behind?
Which of the Beatitudes surprises you most, and why does Jesus call such people blessed?
Jesus says you are salt and light. Where could your life make God visible to others this week?
Jesus treats anger and broken relationships as serious. Is there someone you need to be reconciled with?
Jesus calls us to love our enemies and pray for those who persecute us. Who is hard for you to love right now?
Jesus warns against doing good to be seen. Why does the Father's quiet reward matter more?
Read the Lord's Prayer slowly. Which line do you most need to pray today?
Where is your treasure right now, and what does that say about your heart?
Jesus points to the birds and the lilies. What worry can you hand over to your Father today?
Jesus talks about the log in our own eye. Where might you be quick to judge others but slow to see yourself?
Jesus says the Father gives good things to those who ask. What does this teach about how to pray?
How would you treat someone this week if you lived by the Golden Rule?
The wise builder hears Jesus' words and does them. Which of Jesus' words do you need to put into practice?
Jesus touched a man with leprosy before healing him. What does that touch reveal about Jesus' heart?
The centurion trusted Jesus' word alone. What would it look like to trust Jesus' word like this?
Jesus told would-be followers the cost of following him. What does following Jesus cost you?
The disciples asked, "What sort of man is this?" What does calming the storm show about who Jesus is?
Jesus forgave the paralysed man's sins before healing him. Why might forgiveness be what he needed most?
Jesus ate with tax collectors and sinners. What does "I came not to call the righteous, but sinners" mean for you?
Both the ruler and the woman came to Jesus in desperation. What do you need to bring to Jesus in faith?
Jesus had compassion because the crowds were like sheep without a shepherd. Who around you needs that compassion?
Jesus sent the twelve with his authority. What does it mean that he shares his work with ordinary people?
Jesus warned of opposition but promised the Spirit would give them words. How does this help when faith is hard to speak about?
Jesus says even the sparrows and the hairs of your head are known to God. How does this answer your fears?
Jesus speaks of taking up the cross and even a cup of cold water given. What small act of faithfulness can you do today?
Even John the Baptist had doubts. What does Jesus' gentle answer teach about handling doubt?
Jesus grieved over towns that saw his works and did not repent. Why can seeing God's work still leave a heart unchanged?
The Father reveals these things to "little children." What does it mean to come to God with childlike trust?
Jesus offers rest to the weary and burdened. What burden do you need to bring to him?
Jesus says, "I desire mercy, and not sacrifice." How might rules ever crowd out mercy in your life?
Jesus healed on the Sabbath despite the plotting. What does this show about what the Sabbath is for?
Jesus is the servant who will not break a bruised reed. Where do you need his gentleness?
A tree is known by its fruit, and our words come from the heart. What do your words this week reveal?
In the parable of the sower, which kind of soil best describes your heart right now?
What thorns, like worries or riches, can choke God's word in your life?
The mustard seed and the yeast start small but grow. Where do you see God's kingdom quietly growing?
The man sold everything for the treasure in the field. What makes the kingdom worth everything to you?
John the Baptist died for speaking the truth. What does his faithfulness say to you?
Jesus fed thousands with five loaves and two fish. What little thing could you place in his hands?
Jesus came to his disciples on the water and said, "Take heart; it is I." Where do you need to hear that?
Peter walked on water until he looked at the wind. What makes you take your eyes off Jesus?
Jesus warns about honouring God with lips while hearts are far away. Where might that be true of you?
Jesus says what defiles comes from the heart. What does this teach about where real change must begin?
The Canaanite woman kept asking with humble faith. What does her persistence teach you about prayer?
Jesus again fed a hungry crowd out of compassion. How has Jesus provided for you more than once?
The leaders asked for a sign even after so many. What signs of God's work might you be overlooking?
Jesus asks, "Who do you say that I am?" How would you answer in your own words?
Peter could not accept that Jesus must suffer. Why is the cross so hard for people to accept?
Jesus says whoever loses his life for him will find it. What does denying yourself look like today?
On the mountain the Father says, "Listen to him." What is Jesus saying to you that you need to listen to?
Jesus explains that the Son of Man will suffer. Why does glory come through suffering in God's plan?
Jesus speaks of faith like a mustard seed. What does even small faith in a great God make possible?
Jesus paid the temple tax so as not to give offence. What does this teach about giving up our rights for others?
Jesus put a child in the middle and spoke of humility. What does it mean to become like a child before God?
The shepherd leaves the ninety-nine to find the one. What does this show about how God sees each person?
Jesus gives steps for when a brother sins against you. How could this guide a hard conversation you need to have?
The servant forgiven a huge debt would not forgive a small one. Who might God be asking you to forgive?
Jesus points back to God's design in creation for marriage. What does faithfulness in relationships look like for you?
Jesus welcomed the children the disciples turned away. What does this show about who is welcome with Jesus?
The rich young man went away sad. What might be holding you back from following Jesus fully?
"With God all things are possible." Where do you need to trust this today?
Everyone in the vineyard received the same wage. What does this parable show about God's generosity?
Jesus again foretells his death and rising. How do you think the disciples felt hearing this?
Jesus came "not to be served but to serve." Where can you serve rather than be served this week?
Two blind men cried out until Jesus asked, "What do you want me to do for you?" How would you answer him?
Jesus entered Jerusalem humble and riding on a donkey. What kind of King is he?
Jesus cleared the temple and children praised him. What needs clearing out so your life can be a place of prayer?
Jesus spoke of faith that can move mountains. What mountain do you need to pray about?
One son said no but went; the other said yes but didn't. Which son are you more like?
The king invites everyone to the wedding feast. How are you responding to God's invitation?
"Render to Caesar... and to God the things that are God's." What belongs to God in your life?
Jesus sums up the law as loving God and loving neighbour. Which of these do you find harder right now?
Jesus shows the Messiah is David's Lord, not just his son. Why does it matter who Jesus truly is?
Jesus warns against doing things to be seen and wanting honour. Where are you tempted to seek recognition?
Jesus says they neglected justice, mercy and faithfulness. How can these weightier matters shape your week?
Clean outside, unclean inside. What part of your heart needs Jesus' cleansing?
Jesus longed to gather Jerusalem like a hen gathers her chicks. What does this show about his heart?
Jesus warns of troubles and says the one who endures will be saved. What helps you keep going in faith?
The gospel will be proclaimed to all nations. What part can you play in that?
No one knows the day or hour. What does being ready for Jesus' return look like for you?
The faithful servant is found doing his work when the master comes. What work has God given you to do?
Five virgins were ready and five were not. What keeps your faith burning while you wait?
The master entrusted talents to each servant. What has God entrusted to you, and how are you using it?
"As you did it to one of the least of these... you did it to me." Who are "the least of these" around you?
Those who failed to help did not even realise it. What needs might you be overlooking?
The woman poured costly ointment on Jesus. What would extravagant love for Jesus look like for you?
At the Last Supper Jesus speaks of his body and his blood. What does his sacrifice mean to you?
In Gethsemane Jesus prayed, "Not as I will, but as you will." Where do you need to pray that prayer?
Peter denied Jesus three times and wept. What hope is there for us when we fail like Peter?
Pilate knew Jesus was innocent but gave in to the crowd. When are you tempted to go along with the crowd?
The soldiers mocked Jesus as King. Why did Jesus endure this for us?
Jesus cried, "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?" What does this cry show about the cost of the cross?
The centurion said, "Truly this was the Son of God!" What did he see that brought him to this?
The angel said, "He is not here, for he has risen." What difference does the resurrection make to you today?
The women ran with fear and great joy. Why might both be the right response to the empty tomb?
The leaders paid the guards to spread a story. Why do people resist the truth of the resurrection?
Jesus sends his disciples to all nations and promises, "I am with you always." How does this promise give you courage?
